name: optimize_flow_graph
note: Final pass over the flow graph, called from run_node_optimization_passes unless g_stage_flags & 0x400. Builds blocks (build_flow_blocks) and edges (link_flow_block_targets_and_preds), simplifies every block (simplify_flow_block, freeing those it unlinks), recomputes flags/register masks (scan_flow_block_records(..,1)), then per block: remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds when it has preds, simplify again, delete_repeated_r0_constant_loads when defs[0] & g_reg_mask_table[0] (r0); finally free_flow_block(NULL). Runs only if g_current_node_list != 0 or DAT_00429bec == 0 (DAT_00429bec: set 1 by FUN_0040ea50, 0 by optimize_current_node_list).

name: free_flow_block
note: block != NULL: frees its pred edges (8 bytes each, FUN_00407c30), its code nodes (free_node_list) and the 0x28-byte block. block == NULL: frees every block of g_flow_blocks with its edges but NOT the code, and clears g_flow_blocks. Callers: optimize_flow_graph, build_flow_blocks, unlink_unreferenced_flow_block, simplify_flow_block, next/prev_flow_block_dropping_empty.

name: build_flow_blocks
note: Allocates one 0x28-byte flow_block (FUN_00407a20(0x28)) per code block of g_current_node_list, linked next/prev, head in g_flow_blocks; a block starting with CLABEL/FLABEL gets a dummy pred edge (FUN_00407a20(8), block NULL: entered from outside). After a block with a branch target that ends in an unconditional transfer (flags & 1), unlabeled code blocks are dead: their records are deleted (FUN_00407d80 = delcode) up to an end record (op 0x10); wholly dead blocks have their target label's reference count dropped (FUN_00407f00) and are freed (free_node_list). Calls scan_flow_block_records(block,0) per block. Returns 1, 0 on allocation failure; only caller optimize_flow_graph tests the low byte. (Ghidra currently types the flow blocks here as code_node *.)

name: scan_flow_block_records
note: Walks every psd of the block's nodes: deletes ADD #0 (op 0x60, EAIMM, disp 0, no labels); sets block->flags (8 end record op 0x10, 0x20 CASEJMP, 0x10 LABEL..FLABEL / cleared by any other record, 2 EXIT, 1 EXIT/RETURN/JUMP/BRA/JMP, 4 CALL, 0x40 volatile operand via FUN_004080d0). compute_regs != 0: clears and recomputes live_in[2] / defs[2] from each record's use/def masks (FUN_0040fb20). Callers: build_flow_blocks (0); optimize_flow_graph, remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds, delete_repeated_r0_constant_loads, propagate_r0_constant_to_successors (1).

name: link_flow_block_targets_and_preds
note: For each block (stepping with next_flow_block_dropping_empty): sets block->target to the block whose code->labno == code->target_labno and adds a flow_edge (FUN_00407a20(8)) for it to the target's preds (no duplicates); for a block with a CASEJMP (flags 0x20) it reads the CASEJMP psd's +0x0e short as a label number and gives the block with that label a dummy edge (block NULL). Returns 1, 0 on allocation failure; only caller optimize_flow_graph tests the low byte.

name: collect_pred_blocks_back_to_origin
note: Zeroes out[0..max-1] then fills it with the backward closure of block's predecessors (fall-through prev when it does not end in an unconditional transfer, plus pred edges), stopping at origin (not stored). Returns the count when the closure is complete and origin was reached, 0 when origin is the only predecessor, -1 when a path reaches the first block or an external entry (NULL edge block), origin is never reached, or more than max blocks are needed. Only caller propagate_r0_constant_to_successors (max 10, local array of 10).

name: unlink_unreferenced_flow_block
note: Requires block->prev, no preds and no end record (flags & 8). Removes block's edge from its target's preds (freeing it), drops the target label's reference count (FUN_00407f00), clears block->target; if the target now has no preds, simplifies it with simplify_flow_block (freeing it while it reports unlinked). Then unlinks block from the block list and the code-block chain (prev->code->next_block = block->code->next_block). Returns 1 when unlinked (caller frees it). Callers simplify_flow_block, next/prev_flow_block_dropping_empty all test the low byte.

name: simplify_flow_block
note: Branch clean-up around one block: (1) deletes branches of the preceding block to this block (retarget_block_branch(prev,NULL,0,NULL)); (2) bt+bra -> bf fusion: when the block before prev conditionally branches here and prev is only a branch to T (find_first_branch_record_in_node_chain, FUN_00409760 finds nothing before it), flips its JUMPT/JUMPF, retargets it to T, moves T's pred edge to it and unlinks prev; (3) a block without preds is unlinked when unreachable (prev ends in an unconditional transfer) or label-only, else its label record is deleted and labno cleared; (4) branch chaining: preds of a label-only block, or of a block "label: JUMP X" (next record op 0x24 via FUN_004095e0), are moved to the next block / X (append_pred_edges, retarget_block_branch per pred, FUN_00407fe0 label ref++). Returns 1 when block was unlinked and must be freed; callers optimize_flow_graph, unlink_unreferenced_flow_block and itself test the low byte.

name: retarget_block_branch
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: char retarget_block_branch(flow_block *block, psd *branch, short labno, flow_block *target)
note: branch NULL = find_first_branch_record_in_node_chain(block->code). Requires code->target_labno != 0; branch must be JUMP/JUMPT/JUMPF/RETURN/BF/BT/BRA/BSR/BT_S/BF_S and target's label must equal labno (target NULL requires labno 0). Removes block from its old target's preds (unlink_from_target_preds) and if removed drops that label's reference count (FUN_00407f00); labno 0 deletes the branch record and clears block flags bit 1, else writes labno into branch->ea1->labels->labno1. Sets code->target_labno = labno and block->target = target; does not add the new pred edge. Returns 1 on success; callers simplify_flow_block, remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds test the low byte.

name: unlink_from_target_preds
note: Removes the edge naming block from block->target->preds (requires target and code->target_labno). Does not free the edge. Returns 1 when removed; only caller retarget_block_branch tests the low byte.

name: append_pred_edges
note: Appends the edge list to block->preds (block must have a label; empty preds takes the list as is) unless an existing edge already names edges->block. Returns 1 when appended; callers simplify_flow_block, remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds (ignore the result / test the low byte).

name: next_flow_block_dropping_empty
note: Returns block->next after unlinking and freeing (unlink_unreferenced_flow_block + free_flow_block) following blocks that have no label, no branch target, flags 0 and only DUMMY/LINE/BBGN/BEND records. Callers link_flow_block_targets_and_preds, remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds.

name: prev_flow_block_dropping_empty
note: Mirror of next_flow_block_dropping_empty on block->prev. Only caller simplify_flow_block.

name: remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds
note: For a block starting with LABEL/CLABEL/DLABEL followed by a real record, compares its leading records with each predecessor's (match_leading_records). Sole predecessor that is the previous block and ran the same records (result 1, delete_matched_target_prefix succeeds): the block's copies are deleted and the block rescanned. Predecessor that fully duplicates the block (result 2): its branch is retargeted to the block's target (retarget_block_branch with match_end[1], append_pred_edges, FUN_00407fe0). Similar retargeting of a pred-less fall-through predecessor to the next / next-next block's target when FUN_00410cb0 matches and the g_match_* register masks do not conflict. Only caller optimize_flow_graph (blocks with preds).

name: match_leading_records
note: Compares code's record sequence from rec with other's from its first real record (skipping DUMMY/BBGN/BEND/LINE) through FUN_00410cb0, which writes the first unmatched record of each side to match_end[0]/[1] and the matched part's register masks to g_match_use_lo/hi and g_match_def_lo/hi. Returns FUN_00410cb0's result (0/1/2), or -1 (0xff) when a register is both set and read-before-set in the matched part; only caller remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds tests the low byte against -1/1/2. match_end is a 2-pointer pair (caller locals local_20/local_1c).

name: delete_matched_target_prefix
note: Checks that the predecessor's records from match_end[1] on contain no CASEJMP and touch no register the matched part sets or reads (FUN_0040fb20 against the saved g_match_def/use masks), and that target's records before match_end[0] are not volatile (FUN_004080d0) and reach match_end[0]; then deletes those leading target records (delcode). Returns 1 when deleted; only caller remove_target_prefix_executed_by_preds tests the low byte.

name: delete_repeated_r0_constant_loads
note: Within the block, tracks the last MOVI #imm,R0 (ea2->base 0) and deletes a later MOVI of the same value (FUN_00409840) unless FUN_00409ad0, a bare-immediate MOVI with nothing after it, or volatile; a record setting r0 (g_reg_mask_table[0]) resets the tracking. If a MOVI to r0 is live at the end: rescans the block if anything was deleted, sets flags2 |= 1 and calls propagate_r0_constant_to_successors(block, block, movi), then clears flags2 bits 0..2 of every block. Called from optimize_flow_graph when the block's defs include r0.

name: propagate_r0_constant_to_successors
note: For each successor of block (fall-through next unless it ends in an unconditional transfer, and target) not yet visited (flags2 1): deletes its MOVI #same,R0 loads before r0 is otherwise set when every path into it carries the constant (collect_pred_blocks_back_to_origin(origin, succ, out, 10), and no region block sets r0 otherwise), also deleting the matching loads in the region blocks; flags2 1 visited / 2 r0 set otherwise / 4 loads deleted; rescans changed blocks and recurses. Callers delete_repeated_r0_constant_loads and itself.

name: fold_add_immediates
note: orig: imadd ("imadd start! nodeptr", "imadd end"). For ADD #imm,Rn (no labels, not volatile): finds a later ADD #imm,Rn with no intervening use/set of Rn (FUN_00408b10, FUN_00408120), CASEJMP, or call that clobbers Rn (g_current_request +0x149/+0x150 register conventions), puts the sum into the later one when it fits in -128..127 and deletes the first. For r15 the partner comes from find_next_stack_adjust (FUN_00403b10 adjusts what is between); at EXIT the value folds into the current aux record's +0x24 (g_aux_record_table[g_current_aux_index]). Caller run_node_optimization_passes.

name: fuse_and_imm_with_zero_test
note: Caller run_node_optimization_passes passes a CMP/EQ or TST record and the previous real record (FUN_00409760) when that is op 0x80 (AND). If prev is AND #imm,R0 and test is TST R0,R0 or CMP/EQ #0,R0: deletes test and turns prev into TST #imm,R0 (debug trace "TST code").

name: derive_constant_loads_from_previous
note: orig: labld ("labld start! nodeptr", "labld end"). For MOVI #imm (or a single label) to Rn, scans forward until Rn is used/set, a CASEJMP, or a call that clobbers Rn: a later MOVI whose value (same label) differs by -128..127 becomes ADD #diff,Rn when it loads Rn, else MOV Rn,Rm followed by an inserted ADD #diff,Rm (allocating a new 0x178 node, FUN_0040d8a0(0x178), and shifting records when the node is full). Caller run_node_optimization_passes.

name: find_node_containing_record
note: orig: cnode ("cnode start! psdtbl"). Returns the node of the chain from node whose psd[15] array contains rec, NULL if none. Callers derive_constant_loads_from_previous, FUN_00404bd0, FUN_004059d0.

name: find_next_stack_adjust
note: rec is ADD #imm,R15. Returns the next non-volatile ADD #imm,R15 (or a non-volatile EXIT) after it into which rec can be folded: NULL when a record between uses/sets r15 (FUN_00408120, FUN_00408b10) or a call intervenes unless both adjustments are positive, or when psd flg bits 8/0x20 of rec/partner with the adjustment signs forbid it (EXIT uses the aux record's +0 + +0x24 as its adjustment). Only caller fold_add_immediates.

name: merge_sp_add_flags
note: only caller 00402de0, when it folds two ADD #imm records on r15 (base 0x0f) whose sum fits 8 bits: into->flg |= from->flg & 0x20; sets into->flg bit 8 when the two immediates (ea1->disp) have opposite signs; into->flg |= from->flg & 8

name: fold_decrement_test_into_dt
note: caller run_node_optimization_passes (0040bb90) when request+0x18 != 0 and a JUMPT/JUMPF follows CMP/EQ or TST. test = CMP/EQ #0,Rn, CMP/PL Rn or TST Rn,Rn; prefind (00409760) gets the previous record; if it is ADD #-1,Rn on the same register, calls convert_test_to_dt

name: convert_test_to_dt
note: test->op = DT (0x8a), test->ea1 = cpyea(add->ea2) (00414410), frees test->ea2 (0040f6e0) and clears it, deletes the ADD #-1 record (delcode 00407d80)

name: delete_redundant_extensions
note: called by load_next_code_node on a loaded block (after-load clean-up). For each MOV.B/MOV.W load from memory (@Rn, @(disp,Rn) .. @(R0,GBR); not @-Rn/@Rn+, not volatile per opvolchk 004080d0 or ea flag 0x80) or EXTS/EXTU: walks forward (cnext 004095e0) to an EXTS (after a load/EXTS) or EXTU (after EXTU) of the same size whose source equals the defined register (opeacmp 00409840); stops at a redefinition (regchgchk 00408120) or a CALL/JSR/BSR/TRAPA/BSRF. When the extension writes another register, renames it to the first destination up to its next overwrite (no_use_after_register_clobbered, find_register_overwrite, rename_register_until_redefined), refusing when the renamed register is r0 and a later record needs r0 (CMP/EQ #imm, TST #imm, @(R0,Rn), byte/word @(disp,Rn), GBR modes); then deletes the extension (delcode)

name: delete_extensions_before_narrow_stores
note: called by load_next_code_node on a loaded block. For each EXTS/EXTU Rm,Rn: finds a later MOV of the same size storing Rn to memory (ea2 @Rn/@(disp,Rn)..GBR modes, not volatile, not @-Rn/@Rn+); checks the records in between (refgchk 00408b10, regchgchk, calls via psd_overwrites_register/call_register_effect, r0 constraints as in delete_redundant_extensions, operand size of other uses of Rn); then store->ea1 = cpyea(ext->ea1) (stores Rm directly), renames later uses of Rn to Rm (rename_register_until_redefined) and deletes the extension

name: rename_register_until_redefined
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: char rename_register_until_redefined(psd *rec, unsigned char from_reg, unsigned char to_reg)
note: if rec does not change from_reg (regchgchk): replaces base from_reg by to_reg in ea1 and ea2 where refgchk says the operand refers to it, returns 0. If rec changes from_reg: g_op_dest_operand[op]==2 -> renames in ea1 only; returns 1 (register redefined here, stop). Body returns CONCAT31(..,0/1); callers test only the low byte: 00403cc0, 00403fd0 (one call discards it), 00404750, 00404bd0

name: no_use_after_register_clobbered
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: char no_use_after_register_clobbered(code_node *node, psd *start, unsigned char used_reg, unsigned char clobbered_reg)
note: walks from start; at each record that changes clobbered_reg (regchgchk) or is a call that affects it (call_register_effect != 0), looks at all following records of the block for a reference to used_reg (refgchk on ea1/ea2); returns 1 when none is found. Ghidra bool (1 byte). Callers 00403cc0, 00403fd0

name: defer_post_increments
note: called by load_next_code_node on a loaded block. For each MOV x,Rn (ea2 register) with psd.misc & 0x20 whose next record also has misc & 0x20: if x is memory tries defer_memory_post_increment; otherwise (or if that fails) next = MOVI -> defer_movi_add_after_copy, next = ADD -> defer_add_after_copy. misc 0x20 comes from the .sua (read_sua_pseudo_instruction keeps it for MOVI, read_sua_record_body keeps misc & 0xa0); the patterns handled are those of a post-increment (t = p; p += c; use t), so the flag is likely the code generator's post-increment mark (inference)

name: defer_add_after_copy
note: copy = MOV Rm,Rn (index = its slot in node), next = ADD (misc 0x20). Finds the overwrite of Rn (find_register_overwrite) and the last record using Rn before Rm is referenced or changed; then renames Rn->Rm in the following records (rename_register_until_redefined) while shifting them up one slot (dc_cpycd 004140d0), puts the saved ADD after the last use and deletes the MOV: "MOV Rm,Rn; ADD #c,Rm; use Rn" -> "use Rm; ADD #c,Rm". Same r0 restrictions as delete_redundant_extensions; uses move_extension_and_shift_followers when an EXTS/EXTU of Rm is met

name: defer_movi_add_after_copy
note: as defer_add_after_copy for the three-record form MOV Rm,Rn; MOVI #c,Rk; ADD/SUB Rk,Rm (op 0x60 or 0x63 with misc 0x20; Rk = its ea1 base): saves the MOVI and the ADD/SUB in two local psd copies (initialised from g_empty_psd), renames Rn->Rm in the following records while shifting them up two slots, re-inserts MOVI and ADD/SUB after the last use and deletes the MOV. Uses 004038f0 (cnode: node holding a record) at the node boundary

name: move_extension_and_shift_followers
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: psd *move_extension_and_shift_followers(code_node *node, psd *ext, psd *slot, int ext_index, int slot_index)
note: copies the EXTS/EXTU record ext into the free slot (dc_cpycd), then, if a later record refers to the extension's source before one refers to its destination, copies the records after ext down into the following slots up to that record; returns the next free slot. ext_index/slot_index = slot numbers (0..14) in their nodes. Callers defer_add_after_copy, defer_movi_add_after_copy

name: psd_overwrites_register
note: called on a record that changes reg; returns rec when the write is a pure overwrite, NULL when the old value is also read: NULL for CASEJMP, reg in an @-Rn/@Rn+ operand, a CALL to a runtime routine (label < 0xb7, tmp != reg) that reads reg (00408da0), read-modify-write ops on the destination per g_op_dest_operand (ADD..SUBV, AND/OR/XOR, SHAD, SHLD, XTRCT, 0xb8-0xbe, 0xcc, 0xd6, 0xd8; class-1 ops except 0xb3/0xb4), MOV_LOC to r0, op 0x2e, op 0x31 with an @Rn destination. Callers 00403fd0, 00404750, 00404bd0, 00405600, 00405a80

name: find_register_overwrite
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: psd *find_register_overwrite(code_node *node, psd *start, unsigned char reg, char call_mode, char *in_block)
note: walks from start (cnext): returns the first record that changes reg if it is a pure overwrite (psd_overwrites_register), or a CALL/JSR/BSR/BSRF that clobbers reg (call_register_effect == 1); returns NULL at a TRAPA, a non-overwriting change, a call that needs reg (-1), or the end of the block, where *in_block (optional, preset 1) is set 0. call_mode is passed on to call_register_effect. Callers 00403cc0, 00404750, 00404bd0, 00410f10, 00411610

name: call_register_effect
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: char call_register_effect(psd *rec, unsigned char reg, int mode)
note: for CALL/JSR/BSR/BSRF/TRAPA (other ops return 0): 1 = the call clobbers reg (r0-r3, 0x10-0x13, 0x20, 0x22; with mode != 0 only if regchgchk agrees; a runtime routine CALL, label < 0xb7, that sets or reads reg per 00408400/00408da0), -1 (0xff) = the call needs reg / nothing may move across (argument registers 4-7 and the request+0x149 counted ranges from 0x14 and 0x24, 0x67/0x68, 100/0x65 unless request+0x36, registers in the callee mask request+0x150 after 00409b30(label), TRAPA with r0), 0 = preserved. Callers test ==1 / ==-1 / !=0: 00403fd0, 004045a0, 00404750, 00404bd0, 00405600, 004111b0, 00411930, 004120d0

name: register_referenced_between
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned char register_referenced_between(code_node *node, psd *from, psd *to, unsigned char reg)
note: finds from's node (004038f0 cnode), walks the records after from up to to: returns nonzero if one refers to reg in ea1/ea2 (refgchk); at to itself only a non-immediate ea1 counts. Callers 00404750, 00404bd0, 00410f10, 00411610 (test ==0 / !=0)

name: defer_memory_post_increment
note: load = MOV mem,Rn (misc 0x20, index = its slot). Matches "MOV mem,Rn; ADD #c,Rn (or MOVI #c,Rk; ADD/SUB Rk,Rn); MOV Rn,mem (same size, address not using Rn); ADD #-c,Rn (or the opposite ADD/SUB Rk,Rn)", each misc 0x20, immediates without labels. Collects the address registers (00419060 into g_rec_regs_*), scans for the last use of Rn before a CALL, CASEJMP, barrier (004197b0), redefinition of an address register or of Rk; then moves the following records up over the increment, re-inserts MOVI/ADD/store after that use (0041a950 record copies) and deletes the leftover slot (delcode), dropping the compensating ADD. Returns 1 when transformed, 0 otherwise (CONCAT31); only caller 00404690 tests the low byte

name: read_sua_record_body
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int read_sua_record_body(FILE *in, psd *rec, unsigned char op)
note: caller 0040d470 (passes g_sua_input) for record classes 2-0xd. Stores in into g_sua_read_file and switches on g_sua_op_format[op]: reads 16/4/2/6/5/12/2 bytes into rec fields (+8..+0x17, +0xc.., +0x10, +4); class 8 = machine instruction (filno/linno, expno, flg & 0xe3, misc & 0xa0, then 0/1/2 operands via read_sua_operand); class 9 = read_sua_pseudo_instruction. Returns the byte count of the last read, 0xffffffff on error; fatal 0x131d/0x131e on a bad format

name: read_sua_bytes
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int read_sua_bytes(char *buf, unsigned int count)
note: FUN_0041bff0(g_sua_read_file, buf, count) (fread wrapper); fatal 0xce6 when it returns -1. Callers: the .sua body readers in this slice (004062b0, 00406760, 00407220, 004075e0, 004077a0)

name: read_sua_pseudo_instruction
note: format class 9 of read_sua_record_body: reads the 8-byte common part (filno/linno to +0xc, expno to +8), then per op 0x22..0x31: RETURN/CALL/JUMP/JUMPT/JUMPF (read_sua_label_operand; CALL keeps misc & 0x80, tmp = a byte read), MOV_LOC (frame access: base 0x6c, EAIDREG or EADISP by disp, sptravel), MOVA_LC/MOVA_PC/MOVI/MOVA_FC/0x2c (immediate ea1 + register ea2, label refs via read_sua_label_refs; MOVI keeps misc & 0x20), 0x2e (reg,reg), 0x30/0x31 (@Rn+ / @Rn with register 0x60); allocates the ea records with alloc_zeroed(0xc); fatal 0x131f on other ops

name: read_sua_operand
note: allocates an ea (alloc_zeroed 0xc) as rec->ea1 (which 1) or rec->ea2 (which 2), reads the type byte (low 5 bits + 0x80 flag) and the operand: register kinds (base byte; EACREGD +0x61, EASREGD +100), EADISP (base + 2-byte disp), EAINDEX (index/base nibbles), EAIDPC (disp, base 0x6b), EADSPGBR (4-byte disp, base 0x62, labels), EAIDXGBR (base 0x62), EAIMM (psd_operand_size_bytes bytes, sign extended by set_ea_disp_sign_extended, cut to a byte for AND/OR/XOR/TST/TRAPA, then labels via read_sua_label_refs). Fatal 0x1320 on an unknown kind

name: read_sua_label_operand
note: reads a 2-byte label number, makes rec->ea1 an EAIMM ea with one label_ref (labno1 = that label). Caller read_sua_pseudo_instruction for RETURN/CALL/JUMP/JUMPT/JUMPF

name: set_ea_disp_sign_extended
note: op->disp = the 1-, 2- or 4-byte little-endian value at value, sign extended; fatal 0x1322 for other sizes. Callers 00406760, 00407220

name: read_sua_label_refs
note: reads count 2-byte label numbers and appends them to op->labels: a new label_ref (alloc_zeroed 8) takes labno1; if the last one has labno2 == 0 the next number fills labno2 (label differences); fatal 0x1323 on a short read

name: alloc_zeroed
note: size-class allocator: size must be 1..0x400 and a multiple of 4; finds or adds the class in the g_alloc_class_tables list (blocks of 32 classes, malloc 0x108 via 0041e370), takes memory with alloc_from_chunks and zero-fills it; fatal 0xbcd on failure. Freed by 00407c30(ptr, size). Callers: the .sua readers, 00409d30, 0040b560, 004179a0, 00418e50

name: try_alloc_zeroed
note: same as alloc_zeroed but returns NULL without a fatal error. Callers 00401190 (0x28 flow_block, 8 flow_edge), 004015b0, 0040d8a0

name: alloc_from_chunks
note: creates the first chunk (00407c00, malloc 0x414) if *head is NULL; per chunk: bump-allocates if cursor + size <= end, else pops its free list (free_count--); when none fits pushes a new chunk at the head. Callers alloc_zeroed, try_alloc_zeroed. head takes alloc_chunk ** from types_proposal.h; without the proposal use void **

name: pool_new_chunk
note: Allocates a 0x414-byte pool_chunk (FUN_0041e370(0x414)): +0 next=0, +4 bump=chunk+0x14, +8 end=chunk+0x414, +0xc free list=0, +0x10 free count=0. RETURN: Ghidra's sig says void (undefined) but the only caller FUN_00407b80 uses EAX (iVar1 = FUN_00407c00(); *param_1 = iVar1) - lead must give it a pointer return or the rebuild breaks. Only caller pool_free.

name: delete_psd_record
note: orig: delcode ("delcode start! current code pointer==", "delcode end! delete code pointer=="). Leaves LINE/SWBGN/SWEND/BBGN/BEND/0x10/0x11 records alone; for LABEL..FLABEL/CTBL/CENT clears expno and ea1/ea2 without freeing (ea1 holds the label number); otherwise frees ea1/ea2 with FUN_0040f6e0. note: orig: declab ("declab start!"). If rec's ea1 has a label list whose first labno1 != 0 and the op qualifies (mode 0: any op; mode 1: JUMP 0x24 only; mode 2: JUMP/JUMPT/JUMPF 0x24-0x26), calls decrement_label_ref_count for labno1 and (if nonzero) labno2 of every label_ref. Debug: "labno==", "labtype==", "decriment labno==", "reference count==" (printed through g_current_symbol). Numbers <= 0xb6 are runtime-routine symbols with no record. Callers: release_label_refs_of_record, expand_flagged_record_into_setup_nodes, FUN_004152f0, FUN_00401190, FUN_00401930, FUN_00401ce0.

note: orig: inclad ("inclad start! labno==", "incriment labno=="). Looks up the symbol record (sets g_current_symbol, DAT_0042ad4c) and, for types 2..5, increments the reference count (+0x24) and sets the referenced flag (+1 |= 0x20). Callers FUN_00401a10, FUN_00401fb0, rewrite_branch_target_chains, FUN_00413ce0.

Only caller FUN_004152f0 (casts to short). | return narrowed: callers use the low half (labno = (short))

Callers FUN_00402770, FUN_004028f0, FUN_00403300, FUN_004111b0, FUN_00411930, FUN_004175b0.

note: 0 for labno <= 0xb6 (runtime-routine numbers have no record), else walks g_symbol_hash_table bucket labno % 0x3fd (chain +0x14, key +6). Returns symbol_record * (types_proposal.h). Callers find_label_symbol_of_label_only_block, get_symbol_attr_bit5_or_forced, get_symbol_attr_low_bits, FUN_00402de0, FUN_00403300, FUN_004056d0, FUN_0040d470, FUN_004100a0, FUN_00415690, FUN_00417080.

note: Walks g_current_node_list (next_block +8) backwards from block: returns the nearest preceding block for which find_first_branch_record_in_node_chain is non-null (that callee returns non-null for any block holding a real record: its pbVar4 is assigned for every non-blank record before the transfer test), 0 at the list head. A block not yet linked (being loaded) gets g_last_block (DAT_00429bc4) as predecessor. Callers load_next_code_node, rewrite_branch_target_chains, FUN_00414f40, delete_redundant_conditional_branch.

Returns symbol_record *. Used by load_next_code_node / rewrite_branch_target_chains to set the symbol's forwarding label (+0x12 [savelab]).

name: get_symbol_attr_bit5_or_forced
note: Returns 1 when request byte +0x154 == 3, or when its bit 0 is set and labno <= 0xb6; otherwise 1 iff the symbol (find_label_symbol, stored in g_current_symbol) has attribute bit 0x20 (+2). In emit_literal_pool_entries_for_record a 0 result leads to a literal-pool search/insert (FUN_00418cb0) for the label; meaning of the attribute not proven, so the name is mechanical. Callers emit_literal_pool_entries_for_record, FUN_00419000.

name: get_symbol_attr_low_bits
note: Returns symbol attribute byte (+2) & 3 (0 if no record); stores the record in g_current_symbol. Callers compare the full EAX (CONCAT31 with extraout) against 0/1 together with aux flag bits 0x1800 (emit_literal_pool_entries_for_record, measure_serialized_record_size, FUN_00419030). RETURN: the machine code returns the whole EBX (xor ebx,ebx; mov bl,[sym+2]; and ebx,3; mov eax,ebx) and the callers compare the whole EAX, so the result is an int: as unsigned char the callers' CONCAT31(extraout_var, ...) read uninitialised upper bytes in the rebuild.

name: find_next_nonempty_block
note: Starting at block->next_block, skips blocks that have no labno, no target_labno and only empty/LINE/BBGN/BEND records; returns the first other block (or 0). RETURN: Ghidra's sig says void but EAX holds the block and the caller FUN_00417080 uses it (iVar6 = FUN_00409cd0(..)) - lead must keep a pointer return.

name: load_symbol_aux_record_stream
note: Keep name. Opens path (.asa, or sym.f) rb into g_asa_input; calloc(request+0xac, 0x2c) symbol records (g_code_record_array / g_symbol_record_base), calloc(request+0x110, 0x44) aux records; clears the 0x3fd-bucket g_symbol_hash_table. Tags 1..0xb: symbol record (type, +1 tag bits &0xc0, 8 bytes -> +6 number, +0x18, +8; hashed; +0x1c sequence; type>4: name +0xc; type>6: attribute byte +2, byte +3). Tag 0xc: function symbol + aux record (field order in types_proposal.h), then copies name/aux index/attributes into the existing symbol of the same number (find_symbol_record, fatal 0x131b). Tag 0xd: end, reads g_symbol_record_count; tag 0xe: trailer (2+2+0x20 bytes). request would take the request record (no struct yet). Note: local_5 (second byte of the 2-byte read into local_6) is read uninitialised by Ghidra's view, it is the second byte of that read.

name: read_asa_bytes
note: FUN_0041bff0(g_asa_input, buf, size); fatal 0xce6 on -1. Callers load_symbol_aux_record_stream, read_asa_counted_string.

name: read_asa_counted_string
note: Reads a length byte then that many bytes into a 0x100-byte string pool block (g_string_pool_block / g_string_pool_cursor / g_string_pool_end; new block from FUN_0041e370(0x100) when full), NUL-terminates, returns the string (0 for length 0). Used for symbol names (+0xc).

name: find_symbol_record
note: Hash lookup in g_symbol_hash_table (bucket number % 0x3fd, chain +0x14, key +6) without the 0xb6 cut of find_label_symbol; returns symbol_record * or 0. RETURN: Ghidra's sig says void but the loader uses EAX (iVar8 = FUN_0040a730(..); fatal 0x131b if 0) - lead must keep a pointer return.

name: create_symbol_record
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: symbol *create_symbol_record(char type, char flags, short number)
note: Allocates a 0x2c-byte symbol record from overflow blocks g_extra_symbol_blocks (DAT_00425c9c; 0x588-byte blocks = 8-byte header {short count, short total (first block only), next} + 32 records, zeroed), sets type (+0), flags (+1), number (+6), appends it at the tail of its hash chain, bumps count/total; returns it (symbol_record *). Callers FUN_0040f4e0, FUN_00413ce0 (new labels made by the optimizer).

name: expand_tail_calls_into_epilogue_jumps
note: (was expand_flagged_record_into_setup_nodes) NAME VAGUE/MISLEADING; proposed rename: expand_tail_calls_into_epilogue_jumps. For every JSR/BSR/CALL record with misc & 0x80 (tail call) in g_current_node_list: allocates compute_setup_sequence_node_count() nodes of 0x178 bytes, fills them with build_setup_sequence_node_records (frame pop, register restores, then JMP/BRA/JUMP to the callee), deletes the records after the call up to RETURN/EXIT/JUMP (and that record, decrementing its label), deletes the call, splices the new nodes after the call's node; finally drop_pr_save_restore_if_no_calls. Skips JSR @R1 when the frame is >= 0x80 (r1 is needed for the frame size).

name: count_tail_call_epilogue_nodes
note: (was compute_setup_sequence_node_count) NAME VAGUE; proposed rename: count_tail_call_epilogue_nodes. Counts the records the epilogue needs for the current function's aux record (g_aux_record_table[g_current_aux_index]): 1 jump + 1/2 for the frame pop (aux+0 + aux+0x24 nonzero / >= 0x80) + one per restore (aux+8 bits 0/1, aux+0x17 bits 0/1, PR unless aux flags 0x8000, bits of the aux+4 and aux+6 masks); returns ceil(count / 15) nodes.

name: build_tail_call_epilogue_records
note: (was build_setup_sequence_node_records) NAME VAGUE; proposed rename: build_tail_call_epilogue_records. Fills node's records: ADD #frame,R15 (or MOVI #frame,R1; ADD R1,R15 when >= 0x80; frame = aux+0 + aux+0x24), LDS.L @R15+ of regs 0x68/0x67 (aux+8 bits 1/0), MACL 0x65 / MACH 0x64 (aux+0x17 bits 0/1), PR 0x66 unless aux flags 0x8000, op 0xb0 @R15+ to regs 0x10+i (aux+6 mask), MOV.L @R15+,Rn (aux+4 mask), then CALL->JUMP, BSR->BRA, JSR->JMP with the call's operand (FUN_00414410 copy). Low byte of result: 1 for CALL/BSR (block gets the target label), 0 for JSR (block marked no-fallthrough); only caller expand_flagged_record_into_setup_nodes tests the low byte. Returns a byte (1, 0 or a register number & 0xff); low byte: the only caller, expand_tail_calls_into_epilogue_jumps, tests (char).

name: fill_psd_record
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void fill_psd_record(psd *rec, unsigned char op, char flg, char misc, char tmp, int sptravel, int expno, short filno, unsigned short linno, ea *ea1, ea *ea2)

name: new_ea_operand
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: ea *new_ea_operand(unsigned char type, char base, char index, int disp, label_ref *labels)
note: Allocates a 0xc-byte ea (FUN_0040d8a0(0xc)) and sets type, base, index, disp, labels. RETURN: Ghidra's sig says void but EAX holds the new ea and build_setup_sequence_node_records passes it as ea1/ea2 (uVar3 = FUN_0040b100(..)) - lead must keep a pointer return.

Only caller expand_flagged_record_into_setup_nodes.

name: shcpep_main
note: Keep name. Loads the request (argv[1]), symbol/aux stream, opens .sua/.sub/.ofb/.asb/.lit, run_prep_pass_and_emit_backend_files, closes, writes g_symbol_record_count to request+0xac, stores the request, exits 1.

note: Keep name. Reads the .sua stream, calls optimize_current_node_list per function in a program section, copies the rest of .sua verbatim to .sub when g_copy_rest_verbatim, then writes every symbol record of type 7..0xc (and the aux record of functions) to .asb.

name: optimize_current_node_list
note: Keep name. Loads one function's blocks (load_next_code_node_list until g_section_end), runs the passes, emits the records.

name: free_node_list
note: Keep name and signature. Frees the operands of records up to the first transfer in each node, then pool_free(node, 0x178).

name: report_fatal_message
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void report_fatal_message(short filno, short linno, short msgno)
note: Keep name. FUN_00410e90(filno, linno, msgno, 0); other callers of FUN_00410e90 pass a record's filno/linno as the first two.

name: merge_fallthrough_blocks_and_drop_unused_labels
note: (was merge_adjacent_nodes_and_clear_label_refs) NAME SLIGHTLY WRONG; proposed rename: merge_fallthrough_blocks_and_drop_unused_labels. When g_section_end: clears a block's labno if its symbol (type 2, 5, or referenced 3/4) has reference count 0 and its label psd (+0x28) is the block's first record. Merges a block into the previous one when that one falls through (flags & 1 clear), has no target label and this block has no label: appends the node chain (find_last_node_of_block), ORs flags, adds psd_count and the short at +2, takes target_labno and next_block. It merges blocks (not nodes) and clears block labels (not label_refs).

name: run_node_optimization_passes
note: Keep name. Runs the per-block peephole passes (delete_redundant_loads, delete_redundant_memory_loads, delete_store_load_pairs and unnamed ones), then CMP/EQ or TST after AND (FUN_00403200) and JUMPT/JUMPF after CMP/EQ or TST (FUN_00403b60, when request+0x18) using find_previous_psd_record; g_line_kind5 tracks whether the last LINE record's kind byte (+0x10) was 5.

name: delete_redundant_loads
note: Keep name. orig: delload ("delload start! node pointer==").

name: delete_redundant_memory_loads
note: Keep name. orig: delmemld ("delmemld start! node pointer==").

name: delete_store_load_pairs
note: kept name. orig: delstld ("delstld start! node pointer==%08lx", "delstld end!"). For each store MOV/0xb0/MOV_LOC Rn->mem (flg&3==2, not volatile), walks forward with cnext (FUN_004095e0) to a later load of the same ea (opeacmp FUN_00409840): deletes it (FUN_00407d80 delcode) when it reloads Rn into Rn, else rewrites its source to a copy of Rn (FUN_00414410 cpyea); stops at CALL/JSR/BSR/BSRF/TRAPA/SLEEP/CASEJMP/op 0x10/TAS or a redefinition

note: orig: delstore ("delstore start! node pointer==%08lx", "delstore end!"). A store to memory (ea2 kind @Rn or 8..12, not volatile 0x80) followed by another store to the same ea with the same size (flg&3) and no intervening read, address-register change or barrier (CALL/JSR/BSR/BSRF/TRAPA/SLEEP/CASEJMP/op 0x10) -> deletes the first store (FUN_00407d80)

note: kept name. Ghidra returns byte* (it is &node->flags). Resets g_block_complete/g_block_code_count/g_block_being_loaded, chains load_next_code_node() results through ->next until the block ends; loads one more node when the block ends in a transfer with <0xf0 records and no target; returns g_last_loaded_block. (The label hash walk in the middle is dead code.)

name: load_next_code_node
note: kept. Allocates the 0x178 node via alloc_zeroed_flushing_blocks, copies .sua records (FUN_004140d0 dc_cpycd) into psd slots, clear_psd_record + track_stack_pointer_travel per record, label/branch bookkeeping

name: advance_sua_record_stream
note: kept. Reads the next record into g_current_input_record (read_sua_record, or the pushed-back g_pushed_back_record), sets block/list/section end flags; on FLABEL sets g_stream_func_aux_index and prints the aux register remap ranges (start expno / end expno / before reg / after reg) under stage flag 0x100; calls apply_function_register_remap; at the first code record of a function whose aux +0x28 is r4..r7 (and expno != 0) replaces it with MOV.L Rk,R0 and pushes the real record back

note: Reads one .sua record from g_sua_input: op byte (FUN_0041bff0 fread), body by the per-op class table g_sua_record_class (DAT_00426320) via FUN_004062b0. Class 1: 2-byte label, counted (count_record_label_references) and copied straight to g_sub_output; class 2: sets g_copy_rest_of_input; class 5: pins the symbol (refcount 0x7fff); class 9 saves filno/linno (LINE), class 8 (FLABEL) takes them; class 11 ends the function. Returns 0xff at EOF, -1 on read error, low byte 0 otherwise. Only caller advance_sua_record_stream tests the low byte ((char)==-1)

Callers: load_next_code_node (CALL/MOVA_PC/MOVI/MOVA_FC and final branches), advance_sua_record_stream (FLABEL), read_sua_record

name: count_label_reference
note: |labno| (except -0x8000); for labno > 0xb6 (not a builtin runtime symbol) finds the symbol in g_label_hash_table (fatal 0x1267 if missing), ++sym+0x24 (reference count), sym+1 |= 0x20

name: alloc_zeroed_flushing_blocks
note: Allocates size bytes from the pool allocator FUN_00407a20 and zero-fills; on failure flushes the oldest block of g_current_node_list to the outputs (flush_block_to_output), removes it from its target label's referencing-block list (sym+0x20, 8-byte entries {next, code_node *}, freed with FUN_00407c30(.,8)), free_node_list, and retries. The scan stops at any change or reference of Rn/Rm (regchgchk 00408120, refgchk 00408b10) or a JSR/BSR/CALL/TRAPA/BSRF.

name: reuse_loaded_constants_and_copies

(2) MOV Rm,Rn: a later MOV Rm,Rx is deleted when x == n, else its source becomes Rn (respecting R0-only source modes). (3) ops 0xb3/0xb4/0xd2 on a register: a later identical one is deleted.
